description: Binds an existing ontology's entity/relationship types to data sources without re-importing OWL. Fetches the current definition, matches types by name, and adds DataBindings + Contextualizations in place. Use this for portal-authored ontologies or to add bindings incrementally.
notes: Types are matched by NAME within the 'usertypes' namespace (Fabric addresses types by name; renaming a mapped type is unsupported). Binding-map keys may use the original OWL label ('has site') or the sanitized name ('has_site'). Matching is STRICT: a map key that names no existing type is an error. Entities are bound by convention when the map has no 'entities' block, else only the listed ones; relationships are bound only when named in the map. Re-running is idempotent — prior DataBindings/Contextualizations for the (re)bound types are replaced, other parts are left untouched. DataBindings/Contextualizations conform to the official Fabric schemas; see 'fabio context examples ontology' (ontology/import) for the binding-map format.
